games.title: Atlas Ace
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to use maps, atlases, globes and digital/computer mapping to locate countries and describe features studied; use the eight points of a compass, four and six-figure grid references, symbols and key (including the use of Ordnance Survey maps) to build their knowledge of the United Kingdom and the wider world
games.instruction: Think like an atlas expert, then tap the best answer.
games.hint: Not quite. Think about which part of the atlas helps with this job, then try again.

questions.ask: Which part of an atlas lists places from A to Z with page numbers?
Where would you look to find which pages show each continent?
Which kind of map best shows where the mountains and lowlands are?
Which kind of map best shows country borders and capital cities?
Which kind of map shows rainfall and temperature around the world?
The index says "Lima 34 B3". What does the 34 mean?
The index says "Lima 34 B3". What does the B3 tell you?
When reading a grid reference, which do you read first?
What does the key on a map explain?
What does the scale bar on a map help you work out?
